remarks: Charming 940 sq ft bungalow thoughtfully designed for comfort, style & easy living, ideal for empty nesters or first-time buyers. Features 9' ceilings, vinyl plank flooring throughout & bright, functional layout. Inviting foyer leads to the undeveloped bsmt & hallway to the front primary bdrm w/ lrg windows, 3-pce ensuite w/ stand-up shower w/ glass doors & substantial W/I closet. Main flr also offers laundry & full 3-pce bath w/ stand-up shower w/ glass doors.   Rear of home opens to bright great rm, dining nook, kitchen & 2nd bdrm. Great rm features expansive windows & garden door to backyard. Kitchen boasts peninsula w/ flush eating ledge, Silgranit undermount sink, pendant lighting, built-in microwave, quartz counters, chimney-style hood fan, full-height tile backsplash, upgraded raised cabinet profiles & lrg pantry. Brushed nickel plumbing/lighting fixtures & bsmt rough-in plumbing complete the home. (id:67522)
courtesy: David Lam, Exp Realty and Joe Tolvay, Exp Realty
